svg.title: Estimating a count from a count-min sketch with three rows
svg.desc: A 3 by 8 grid of counters, each row with its own hash function and each row summing to 20 events. The key cats hashes to a cell holding 9 in row 1 (cats 5 plus dogs 4), 5 in row 2 (no collision) and 7 in row 3 (cats 5 plus tea 2). The estimate is the minimum, 5, the true count.
svg.text: count-min sketch: 3 rows × 8 columns, N = 20 events
the cell each row's hash picks for "cats"
collisions only add, so the minimum is never below the truth
